annotations.title: Add chats to the sync list

description: Puts supergroups and channels on the sync list, so the mirror keeps their messages from now on. Changes only the local mirror and the sync list; nothing changes at Telegram. Needs the sync service running. The list holds at most 30 chats. The whole call is refused when any chat cannot be listed: private chats, bots, basic groups and Saved Messages are always kept, and channels can be listed only with the channels setting on. Chats come as ids from `telegram_chat_read` method `list`, never names. A chat already on the list is reported under `listed` and left as it is, so repeating a call is harmless. If the call ends `uncertain`, check `telegram_sync_read` before trying again.

account.description: The account label; may be left out when only one account is logged in.

chats.description: The chats to change, by id from `telegram_chat_read` method `list`, such as -1001234567890: 1 to 30 distinct ids. A name, username or phone number is not a chat.

name: telegram_sync_add

added.description: The chats now on the sync list that were not on it before; they are being seeded.

limit.description: The most chats the sync list holds: 30.

listed.description: The chats that were already on the sync list; nothing changed for them.

note.description: What happens to the added chats and how to read them.

size.description: How many chats the sync list holds now.
